Name: Ganryu
Text: Your throws, slams and attacks with "Ganryu" in the title cannot be blocked by effects. (*) Your rival's throws cost +1 energy to play.

Name: JACK-5
Text: When one of your Launchers hits, your next attack in that combo does +2 damage. (*) When you play a low attack in a combo after your previous attack in that combo hits, that attack does +1 damage.

Name: Julia Chang
Text: When you hit with a throw, you may pay 1 energy to knock down your rival. (*) When you do 10 or more damage with a punch, look at your rival's hand and choose a card. Your rival discards that card.

Name: Kuma
Text: When one of your Launchers hits, you may discard a card to draw a card. (*) When one of your Knock Downs hits, your rival discards a card to draw a card.

Name: Lee Chaolan
Text: Your attacks that stay in the arena to be played again cannot have their damage lowered or their costs raised. (*) Your weapons may link into kicks and vice versa.

Name: Wang Jinrei
Text: When you chip cards, put them at the bottom of your deck instead of your discard pile. (*) When you flip an event, shuffle the top 4 cards of your discard pile into your deck.

Name: Yoshimitsu
Text: Your weapons that have a printed cost of 0 are unblockable. (*) Your rival must discard a card from his hand before playing a weapon. Otherwise, that attack does 0 damage.

Name: Betrayal
Text: Flip at the start of Set. Take control of one of your rival's events until the end of the turn.

Name: Break Dancing
Text: Flip during Set. Put X cards from your discard pile into your energy pile. X = the number of low kicks in your energy pile to a max of 5.

Name: Care Free
Text: Flip during Set. Shuffle 3 cards from your energy pile into your deck to discard 2 cards in your rival's energy pile.

Name: Disgusted
Text: Flip at the start of Discard. Your rival discards X cards. X = the number of copies of the card "Girth" in your discard pile multiplied by 2.

Name: Friendship
Text: Flip as an action in Battle. You draw 2 cards and your rival draws 3 cards. (*) Your attacks do +1 damage in your next action. (*) Your rival's attacks do +2 damage this turn. (*) Remove this card. (*) Limit 2 per deck.

Name: I'll See You in Hell
Text: Flip when your rival is knocked down from an attack. Your rival discards the top 10 cards of his deck. (*) Your action ends when that attack finishes. (*) Remove after use.

Name: Legendary Showdown
Text: Flip at the start of Draw. For this turn, you and your rival cannot raise and/or lower the damage and costs of each others cards.

Name: Oddities
Text: Flip as an action in Battle. Your rival's attacks this turn do -2 damage.

Name: Powerful Fists
Text: Flip when one of your punches is blocked. Draw X cards. X = the printed cost of the punch + 1 (*) Remove this card.

Name: Sisterly Hate
Text: Flip when you play a weapon. That weapon gains "Knock Down" and does +X damage. X = the number of weapons in your discard pile to a max of 10.

Name: Student and Teacher
Text: Flip when your rival plays an attack that has the same title as a card in his energy pile. Block that attack. (*) Search your deck for an attack that has the same title as a card in your energy pile.

Name: The Better Man
Text: Flip as an action in Battle, discard 2 attacks from your hand to shuffle the bottom 10 cards of your discard pile into your deck. (*)Remove this card.

Name: The Villain of the Story
Text: Flip when your rival flips an event. Your rival's next attack this turn costs +2 energy.

Name: Tragic Reunion
Text: Flip at the start of Draw, you cannot draw cards this turn. Search your discard pile for a card and put it in your hand. Remove this card. (*) Limit 1 per deck.

Name: Abolishing Fist
Text: Your next attack this action gains "Knock Down." (*) HIT - Your attacks this action gain, "When played while your rival is knocked down, he discards the top 2 cards of his deck."

Name: Birds Flock
Text: When played while your rival is launched, you may pay 1 energy to search your deck for a block and put it into your hand.

Name: Bruce Irvin's Gatling Kicks
Text: HIT - This attack stays in the arena to be played X times this turn. X = the number of kicks in your energy pile to a max of 5. If it's in the arena when Battle ends, discard it.

Name: Bulldog
Text: If you have lowered the damage on any of your rival's attacks this turn, this attack gains "Knock Down."

Name: Bulldog Bite
Text: Launcher-- If your next attack is a high throw, your rival is able to play a low block to block it. Only a low block can block that throw.

Name: Cobra Sword
Text: When played, shuffle your energy pile into your deck.

Name: Double Hammer
Text: Launcher-- If your rival has 7 or more cards in his hand, this attack is unblockable.

Name: Dragon's Fire
Text: Launcher-- If you played a low block in your rival's previous action this turn, this attack does +4 damage.
